mapper.sql: c.id AS chartbookId, c.owner_key AS ownerKey, c.status AS chartbookStatus, p.chartbook_id AS profileRowId, COALESCE(p.version, 0) AS version, COALESCE(p.instructions, '') AS instructions, COALESCE(p.goal, '') AS goal, COALESCE(p.summary, '') AS summary, COALESCE(p.glossary_json, JSON_OBJECT()) AS glossaryJson, COALESCE(p.default_style_json, JSON_OBJECT()) AS defaultStyleJson, COALESCE(p.stable_constraints_json, JSON_ARRAY()) AS stableConstraintsJson, COALESCE(p.profile_state, 'EMPTY') AS profileState, COALESCE(p.updated_at, c.updated_at) AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chartbook c LEFT JOIN chartbook_profile p ON p.chartbook_id = c.id AND p.owner_key = c.owner_key WHERE c.owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND c.id = #{chartbookId}

SELECT chartbook_id AS chartbookId, owner_key AS ownerKey, version, instructions, goal, summary, glossary_json AS glossaryJson, default_style_json AS defaultStyleJson, stable_constraints_json AS stableConstraintsJson, profile_state AS profileState, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM chartbook_profile_version WHERE owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND chartbook_id = #{chartbookId} AND version = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO chartbook_profile (chartbook_id, owner_key, instructions, goal, summary, glossary_json, default_style_json, stable_constraints_json, profile_state, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{chartbookId}, #{ownerKey}, '', '', '', JSON_OBJECT(), JSON_OBJECT(), JSON_ARRAY(), 'EMPTY', 0, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE chartbook_profile p INNER JOIN chartbook c ON c.id = p.chartbook_id AND c.owner_key = p.owner_key SET p.version = #{version}, p.instructions = #{instructions}, p.goal = #{goal}, p.summary = #{summary}, p.glossary_json = #{glossaryJson}, p.default_style_json = #{defaultStyleJson}, p.stable_constraints_json = #{stableConstraintsJson}, p.profile_state = #{profileState}, p.updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE p.owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND p.chartbook_id = #{chartbookId} AND p.version = #{expectedVersion} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chartbook_profile_version (chartbook_id, owner_key, version, instructions, goal, summary, glossary_json, default_style_json, stable_constraints_json, profile_state, updated_at, created_at) VALUES (#{chartbookId}, #{ownerKey}, #{version}, #{instructions}, #{goal}, #{summary}, #{glossaryJson}, #{defaultStyleJson}, #{stableConstraintsJson}, #{profileState}, #{updatedAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO chartbook_profile_audit (id, owner_key, chartbook_id, idempotency_key, version, content_digest, created_at) VALUES (#{auditId}, #{ownerKey}, #{chartbookId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{version}, #{contentDigest}, #{createdAt})
